name: terraform
description: Inspect Terraform state and saved plans in an initialized working directory. Partial community schema; init, plan, apply, and state edits are excluded. Backends and provider plugins may have side effects, so mutation status is unknown.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Display current state or a saved state or plan file. JSON includes sensitive values in plaintext.

args.name: file
args.description: Optional saved state or plan path.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Human-readable state or plan by default; -json emits a structured object.

commands.name: output
commands.description: Read root module outputs from state. JSON and raw output reveal sensitive values.

args.name: -raw
args.description: Print a named string, number, or boolean without JSON encoding.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: All outputs or a named value; -json returns JSON and -raw returns a scalar string.

commands.name: state list
commands.description: List resource addresses recorded in state.
